findings.title: Reject invalid JWT (empty-bearer)
findings.remediation: Strict JWT verification (signature, alg whitelist, expiry)

findings.title: Reject invalid JWT (garbage)
findings.remediation: Strict JWT verification (signature, alg whitelist, expiry)

findings.title: Reject invalid JWT (truncated)
findings.remediation: Strict JWT verification (signature, alg whitelist, expiry)

findings.title: Employee PUT /users/{id} with role=tenant_admin
findings.remediation: Deny role changes on self-update; whitelist fields

findings.title: Employee PATCH /users/{id} role
findings.remediation: Whitelist updatable fields server-side

findings.title: Role remains employee after elevation attempt
findings.remediation: Audit update handlers; never trust client role claim alone

findings.title: Access JWT remains valid after logout
findings.impact: Stolen access token usable after user logout
findings.remediation: Revoke/blacklist access tokens; keep access TTL short

findings.title: Refresh token usable after logout
findings.remediation: Invalidate refresh tokens server-side on logout

findings.title: Native exp claim enforcement — observe JWT exp and require retest with aged token
findings.impact: Expired tokens accepted would extend session risk
findings.remediation: Enforce exp/nbf; clock skew limits; reject expired access tokens

findings.title: Employee GET /users?user_id=<manager>
findings.remediation: Object-level authorization on user reads

findings.title: API CORS configuration review
findings.remediation: Restrict Access-Control-Allow-Origin; avoid * with credentials

findings.title: UI Content-Security-Policy / framing headers
findings.remediation: Deploy strict CSP, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, nosniff

findings.title: Upload endpoint probe /documents/upload
findings.impact: Unsafe upload surfaces if present without validation
findings.remediation: Authz + type/size/magic-byte checks + malware scan + private storage

findings.title: Login hint response for nonexistent user
findings.remediation: Uniform responses for known/unknown usernames

findings.title: Active SQL injection payload testing not executed
findings.evidence: No exploit payloads sent to remote endpoints. Recommend staging suite + query parameterization audit.
findings.impact: Data breach / auth bypass via injection
findings.remediation: Parameterized queries/ORM; WAF; staging SQLi regression

findings.title: Active XSS payload injection not executed
findings.evidence: CSP/header review performed. Recommend stored/reflected XSS tests on notes/bills/profile in staging.
findings.remediation: Output encoding; CSP; sanitize rich text fields

findings.title: CSRF residual risk with Bearer-auth APIs
findings.evidence: Primary API auth uses Authorization Bearer (reduces classic cookie CSRF). Confirm no cookie-only state-changing routes.
findings.impact: Unauthorized state changes from malicious sites
findings.remediation: Keep Bearer-only for mutations; SameSite if cookies used

findings.title: UI deep-links expose admin chrome to Manager/Supervisor/Employee (prior QA)
findings.evidence: See docs/QA master catalog: Create Tenant, Tenant Admins, Super Admin, Plans, Company Settings
findings.impact: Client-side privilege exposure; may pair with weak API RBAC
findings.remediation: Route guards + server enforcement; hide admin nav
